copy.tagline: 学会端到端测试网页应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发网页应用并想系统测试其功能
copy.tagline_en: Learn to test web apps end-to-end
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web apps and want systematic testing

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按这套规则测试 Web 应用:先摸清页面、接口和组件,再用 Playwright 脚本跑浏览器测试,可加截图与无障碍检查。测试覆盖主流用户流程、登录、关键操作和报错处理,遵循反模式清单。
howto.when: 当你说要测试某个 Web 应用、做 E2E(端到端)测试或深度审计时,Claude 会进入这套测试流程。

say.text: 用 Playwright 跑 https://example.com,并截图。
say.note: 会运行脚本并输出截图。

say.text: 对 https://example.com 做无障碍检查。
按 E2E 最佳实践给这个 Web 应用写测试。
say.note: 会先梳理路由再组织用例。

howto.what_en: Claude tests web apps by mapping routes, APIs, and components, then runs Playwright browser tests with optional screenshots and accessibility checks, covering main flows, auth, key actions, and error handling per anti-pattern guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to test a web app, run E2E/end-to-end tests, or do a deep audit.

say_en.text: Run the Playwright test for https://example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Executes the script and outputs a screenshot.

say_en.text: Run an accessibility check on https://example.com.
Write E2E tests for this web app following best practices.
say_en.note: Maps routes first, then organizes cases.
